Senses.Explanation: Literally, 'main cord and ancestral line' (綱宗): the main cord of a net (綱) joined to the ancestral line or school (宗). In Chan records it names the organizing framework by which a lineage's inherited sayings and distinctions are arranged and identified. The preface to the Eye of Humans and Gods (人天眼目) places 'the key outlines of the five houses' (五宗綱要) beside 'the terms of the lineage framework' (綱宗語句), including the names and decisive details that an abbot is expected to know. Other texts specify 'the Linji lineage framework' (臨濟綱宗), 'the Dongshan lineage framework' (洞上綱宗), and 'the Caodong lineage framework' (曹洞綱宗), showing that the compound can be qualified by a named house. A record quoting Yantou says, 'Only recognize the lineage framework; originally there is no actual thing' (但識綱宗本無實法), and another version gives, 'For the great governing lineage framework, first one must recognize the phrase' (大統綱宗先須識句). The term also occurs with verbs such as establish, uphold, display, grasp, and restore, and with enumerated house vocabulary such as Linji's 'three mysteries and three essentials' (三玄三要).
Senses.Note: The exact headword occurs 689 times in 188 allowlisted texts. Searches for definition patterns including 'as for the lineage framework' (綱宗者), 'the so-called lineage framework' (所謂綱宗), 'it is called the lineage framework' (謂之綱宗 and 名為綱宗), 'call it the lineage framework' (喚作綱宗), and 'what is the lineage framework?' (何謂綱宗 and 如何是綱宗) did not produce a simple dictionary-style self-definition. The strongest structural evidence is instead the corpus's explicit pairing of 'five-house key outlines' (五宗綱要) with 'lineage-framework terms' (綱宗語句), Yantou's two quoted formulas, and the named-house collocations. This is a corpus-wide category; a Linji or Caodong collocation does not create a master-specific sense.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian (永覺元賢禪師廣錄). Lin Zhifan, who signs Yongjue Yuanxian's biographical record as its author (菩薩戒弟子林之蕃謹譔), says that the Caodong lineage framework had been confused and was restored to its former track. Yongjue Yuanxian is the biography's subject, not the narrative speaker.
